Timestamps / Chapters -
Konsept tok ki is kari men do. vikas divyakirti ne bhartiy nagrikta se sanbandhit vivadon ki aitihasik prishthabhumi vistar men prastut ki hai jiski jankari ke bina CAA, NRC, NPR ke vartaman vivad ko gahraee se nahin samjha ja sakta hai. 1947 se 2014 tak bharat men aapravas sankat kaise-kaise barha aur nagrikta ke kanun kaise badalte gae; kin sarkaron ne is prashn par pray nishkriyta barti aur kinhonne aakramak rukh akhtiyar kiya; asam sankat, asam samjhauta aur IMDT aikt is itihas men kya mahattv rakhte hain - ye sabhi prashn is vidiyo men suljhae gae hain.
